method: Solid magenta key; BOX registration at 8x; palette lock without dithering; exact RGBA mode of all 64 samples per pixel with lexicographic ties; source-supported native contour cleanup; component compositing.

recipes.clear-day: Composite nine separately registered components from sun-a: disc,n,ne,e,se,s,sw,w,nw.
recipes.clear-night: night-a-moon, with both original stars excluded; night-a-star, enlarged to 7x7.
recipes.overcast: Slate cloud-c copies translated (-1,1) and (1,8). Same mask and scale.
recipes.rain: White cloud-c plus rain-a: three separately registered 5x7 slanted strokes.
recipes.heavy_rain: Slate cloud-c plus heavy-a: five copies of the first drawn 5x9 stroke.
recipes.storm: Dark slate cloud-c plus retained-bolt, extracted from the starting storm icon and outlined inside existing opaque pixels.
recipes.snow: White cloud-c plus snow-a-large: two 7x7 cross flakes.
recipes.hail: Slate cloud-c plus hail-a-large: three separated 5x5 rounded pellets.
recipes.wind: wind-b-separated: independent registration of three drawn gusts.
recipes.sandstorm: sand-b: three asymmetric ochre dust bands.
recipes.heat_wave: Upper 13 rows of the assembled clear-day sun, with heat-b-waves: two separately registered 22x5 ripples.

selection.cloud: c: three broad puffs; a/b have a taller central peak.
selection.sun: a, components registered independently; b has less even rays.
selection.night: a, keeping one enlarged four-point star.
selection.blizzard: b: fewer branches, stronger native silhouette.
selection.wind: b: straighter gusts and offset open hooks.
selection.sandstorm: b: asymmetric dense bands with open channels.
selection.heat_wave: b ripples with the same sun as clear-day; a is too dense at native size.
